hooks.note: Native FUN_00014ae0+0xc, after null and lifecycle guards and before push {r4,r5,lr}; sub sp,#0x4c. At this point r0 still holds descriptor, LR/SP unchanged. The launcher instructions are identical in both firmware. Exact apl_bdv/apl_meda_bdplay/apl_meda_dvdv non-debug paths use fork+execve with pre-main waits; only apl_bdv receives region policy. Descriptor slots: 2 debug selector string, 3 executable path, 4 argv, 6 child PID, 7 lifecycle. All other launches delegate the original trampoline.

Public EV_wait_message entry. Retry only the seven audited native medm PCA/FLC callers; all other callers retain original return behavior. First already-in-flight wait is not retroactively protected. Native module prepare verifies the full mapped provider hash before this shared installation.

bindings.note: Runtime debug selector string compared by the original launcher, not a guessed literal.

lifecycle: Long-lived media manager; install before the next disc launch. It does not alter an already-running apl_bdv.
